SELECT DATE(time) AS utc_date, COUNT(*) AS earthquake_count
FROM data
GROUP BY DATE(time)
ORDER BY utc_date

SELECT magtype AS mag_type, AVG(depth) AS avg_depth, COUNT(*) AS earthquake_count
FROM data
WHERE mag IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY magtype
ORDER BY earthquake_count DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN depth < 10 THEN 'under_10_km'
    WHEN depth >= 10 AND depth < 50 THEN '10_50_km'
    WHEN depth >= 50 AND depth < 100 THEN '50_100_km'
    WHEN depth >= 100 THEN '100_km_or_more'
  END AS depth_band,
  COUNT(*) AS earthquake_count
FROM data
GROUP BY depth_band
ORDER BY earthquake_count DESC
SELECT date, tmax_c FROM data ORDER BY tmax_c DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, SUM(precipitation_mm) AS total_precipitation_mm
FROM data
WHERE date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
ORDER BY month
SELECT COUNT(*) AS days_with_snow, SUM(snowfall_mm) AS total_snowfall_mm FROM data WHERE snowfall_mm > 0

SELECT country, gdp_current_usd
FROM data
WHERE year = 2024 AND gdp_current_usd IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gdp_current_usd DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country, population
FROM data

ORDER BY population DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  (SELECT population FROM data WHERE country = 'China' AND year = 2024) -
  (SELECT population FROM data WHERE country = 'China' AND year = 2015) AS population_change,
  ROUND(
    ((SELECT population FROM data WHERE country = 'China' AND year = 2024) -
     (SELECT population FROM data WHERE country = 'China' AND year = 2015)) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT population FROM data WHERE country = 'China' AND year = 2015),
    2
  ) AS change_rate_pct
FROM data
WHERE country = 'China' AND year IN (2015, 2024)
LIMIT 1

SELECT country, gdp_current_usd / CAST(population AS REAL) AS gdp_per_capita
FROM data
WHERE year = 2024 AND population IS NOT NULL AND gdp_current_usd IS NOT NULL AND population > 0
ORDER BY gdp_per_capita DESC
LIMIT 10
